name: Phishing EOA Incident
rootCause: On April 28, 2025, 3,520 BTC (≈$330.7M) was stolen from an elderly U.S. Bitcoin holder by a social engineering attacker. The funds were rapidly laundered through multiple exchanges and converted to Monero, rendering most assets untraceable and unrecoverable. About $7M was reportedly frozen by Binance before conversion. An attacker manipulated an elderly individual into granting wallet access or authorization for a high-value transfer. No technical vulnerability was exploited. The loss was due to off-chain social engineering and the absence of operational safeguards for large, personally managed balances.
